gates.reason: Instruction loading is restricted to bounded regular non-symlink SIDEKICK.md files; only digests and metadata leave the loader, and no ~/.claude content or credentials are read or emitted.

Behavior-context provenance records model/version/configuration identifiers, canonical SHA-256 digests, source scope, character length, and truncation state reproducibly; no unsupported recommendation or validated fix claim is produced.

Filesystem discovery is capped at 30 ancestors, each instruction file is capped at 1 MiB, captured text is capped at 6,000 characters, and the work is performed once per context capture without an unbounded hot-path loop.
